dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A prominent 'O' shaped structure posterior to the flipper exhibits a sharp, high-contrast light perimeter with a defined gradient transition to a darker core. Above the flipper, an open 'C' shaped annulus displays a feathered outer boundary. Three smaller, high-intensity 'O' rings are visible in the upper mid-body, showing high pixel intensity at the edges transitioning rapidly to a lower intensity interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of localized, irregular high-intensity white blobs is concentrated in the mid-dorsal region. These blobs lack internal gradients and are tightly clustered. Several larger, solid low-intensity dark blobs are present near the transition between the neck and shoulder regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli form an irregular quadrangle. The distance between the centroid of the 'C' structure above the flipper and the 'O' structure posterior to it is roughly equal to the distance between the 'O' structure and the cluster of smaller rings further dorsal, forming an approximately isosceles triangular relationship among these three points.

other_distinctive_markers: The muzzle region displays four distinct, high-contrast dark circular spots arranged in a near-linear horizontal configuration, separate from the main topological body pattern.
